mapper.select: SELECT orId,title,content,orderId FROM overallresult WHERE orderId=#{orderId} ORDER BY orId

SELECT r.cirId AS report_id, r.ciId AS item_id, r.ciName AS item_name, r.orderId AS report_order_id, d.cidrId AS detail_id, d.name AS detail_name, d.unit AS detail_unit, d.minrange AS detail_min, d.maxrange AS detail_max, d.normalValue AS detail_normal, d.normalValueString AS detail_normal_text, d.type AS detail_type, d.value AS detail_value, d.isError AS detail_error, d.ciId AS detail_report_id, d.orderId AS detail_order_id FROM cireport r LEFT JOIN cidetailedreport d ON d.ciId=r.cirId AND d.orderId=r.orderId WHERE r.orderId=#{orderId} ORDER BY r.cirId,d.cidrId
SELECT state FROM orders WHERE orderId=#{orderId} AND paymentStatus='PAID' FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cireport WHERE orderId=#{orderId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cidetailedreport WHERE orderId=#{orderId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cidetailedreport WHERE orderId=#{orderId} AND (value IS NULL OR TRIM(value)='')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM overallresult WHERE orderId=#{orderId}
mapper.update: UPDATE overallresult SET title=#{title}, content=#{content} WHERE orId=#{orId} AND orderId=#{orderId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM overallresult WHERE orId=#{orId} AND orderId=#{orderId}
mapper.update: UPDATE cidetailedreport SET value=#{value},isError=#{isError} WHERE cidrId=#{cidrId} AND ciId=#{ciId} AND orderId=#{orderId}
